tests: View > Zoom Out goes 100 %, 75 %, 50 % and then stays at 50 %, though the zoom box offers 25 %
steps:
1. Open a form and click it, so that the designer has the focus.
2. Choose View > Zoom Out four times. The zoom box reads 75 %, 50 %, 50 %, 50 %; it offers 25 %, which it can choose itself.
Control: View > Zoom In from 50 % goes to 75 %.
